showcase.problem: During construction, design variations arise requiring manual documentation for cost estimation and site instructions. Each Request for Variation Order (RVO) requires approximately one hour to examine drawings, pinpoint variances, and document details. With 100-200 RVOs per project, this represents 200 man-hours of repetitive work.
showcase.proposedSolution: Automated system for identifying design changes by comparing tender drawings with amended drawings. The system lists differences, highlighting updated dimensions, new materials, or additional building elements like doors or windows.
showcase.approach: Two-step process: (1) Auto-comparison of drawings - scale, compare, identify/highlight changes, assign unique identity; (2) Auto-generation of texts and descriptions from images using trained model.
showcase.methods: PDF drawing comparison using standardized format, YOLOV8 image detection machine learning to identify building elements, automated measurement and documentation of changes.
showcase.impact: Saves approximately 200 man-hours per project. Potential applications include tracking building changes over time, preparation for A&A works, spotting discrepancies between versions, and costing design options. Available at: https://object-detection-from-plan-drawings-2wv5vdvcfmezpgjxkixjbq.streamlit.app/YOLO_for_plans

showcase.problem: Huge effort and time needed for fire code compliance. Checks are laborious, prone to human error, and cannot be claimed as additional cost. Computational methods for automation are complex and may require many hours of computation.
showcase.proposedSolution: AI application to identify locations of FSSD items (Fire Extinguishers, Hydrants, Hosereels, Risers, Access Panels) to be placed on plans. Automated checks highlight errors or non-compliances.
showcase.approach: Revit plugin with API server-based solver logic, allowing multiple users simultaneously. Automated compliant placement and checking workflow.
showcase.methods: Machine learning for placement optimization, automated compliance verification, BIM integration through Revit plugin.
showcase.impact: 99% accuracy target, reduces human errors, saves design hours, allows focus on coordination instead of repetitive compliance checks. Scalable to any plan size, adaptable to other compliance workflows. Changes how Architects and Technical managers work.

showcase.problem: Hard to get overview of existing structure's Full Carbon Lifecycle footprint due to lack of data and calculation complexity. No open data source or calculator for quick full-cycle carbon estimates. Designers, developers, and owners lack knowledge to calculate embodied and operational carbon emissions.
showcase.proposedSolution: ChatGPT-based calculator using NLP to process large datasets. Trained database of ICE data, Energy Usage Data, and Building Data to instantly estimate Full Carbon Life Cycle through LLM interface.
showcase.approach: Five-step workflow: (1) Get building data from OpenStreetMap API, (2) Identify materials from ICE database, (3) Calculate embodied carbon, (4) Calculate operational carbon using EMA data, (5) Calculate carbon sequestration needs.
showcase.methods: Natural language processing, ICE database correlation for materials, EMA carbon use data integration, automated calculations for sequestration strategy.
showcase.tools: ChatGPT (Plus account required), OpenStreetMap API, ICE Database, EMA Energy Data
showcase.impact: Provides instant full-cycle carbon footprint estimates for buildings. Helps understand environmental impact, calculates trees needed for carbon offset over building lifecycle. Available on ChatGPT store as plugin.

showcase.problem: Time-consuming search through multiple PDFs and websites from different authorities for building regulations. Finding appropriate regulations is like finding needle in a haystack. Typically takes 2-3 days for single designer to extract and compile regulations.
showcase.proposedSolution: GenAI ChatBot using natural language that generates accurate, precise, complete list of regulations for given site instantly. Harmonized across multiple agencies (URA, SCDF, LTA), with errors/ambiguities flagged, up-to-date regulations, formatted with agency, source link, and date.
showcase.approach: Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) technique using LlamaIndex framework. Multi-stage process: condensing query, retrieving context, generating response. Explored prompt engineering (Zero-shot Chain-of-Thought, Generated Knowledge, Self-Consistency).
showcase.methods: Data formatting into computer-readable formats, document splitting into chapters/sections/clauses, embedding models, Q&A corrections, hierarchical chat frameworks for complex queries.
showcase.tools: LlamaIndex, OpenAI ChatGPT (3.5 & 4 turbo), Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, MistralAI, RAG
showcase.impact: Reduces compilation time from 3 days to minutes. Ensures reliable up-to-date results harmonized across agencies. Solving at design phase avoids months of downstream compliance work. Future: multi-agent orchestration for complex queries, multi-modal support for images/diagrams.

useCases.title: Architectural Ideation and Visualisation with Generative AI

showcase.problem: Consultants challenged by demanding requirements with tight deadlines, rapid AI advancements requiring quick adaptation, skills gaps especially for SMEs. High demand for quality visualizations with frequent changes is difficult to deliver within tight timeframes.
showcase.proposedSolution: Exploration of GenAI tools (Midjourney, Stable Diffusion with ComfyUI) for quick architectural ideation and visualization. Development of accessible learning guides shared among community of practice.
showcase.approach: Combined online platforms (Midjourney, Promeai) for quick brainstorming with locally-run setups (Stable Diffusion with ControlNet) for control. AI model training for diverse styles using custom datasets (Brutalism, Modern Tropical). Using massing models as base for improved accuracy.
showcase.methods: Rapid iteration using textual prompts, customized model training with 25+ images in safetensor format, sketch outlines/depth maps from massing models to guide GenAI, proprietary dataset development.
showcase.tools: Midjourney, Promeai, Stable Diffusion, ComfyUI, ControlNet, SketchUp, Rhino, Blender
showcase.impact: Saves time and effort in design exploration. Learning guides serve as quick reference for consultants. Addresses skill gaps through knowledge sharing. Future: BIM integration for automated drawing generation, topic-focused hands-on activities for competency building.

useCases.title: Draco - Sketching/Collaging to AI Render tool

showcase.problem: Most generative AI tools use text-to-image or image-to-image models, assuming users have mastered English vocabulary to communicate intentions. This is not how architects/designers typically develop ideas - they prefer to sketch and collage their design intentions.
showcase.proposedSolution: Human-driven AI design process: tool-agnostic, web-based real-time sketching/collaging tool allowing architects to add sketches, use digital pen, add images from web, and see design intent render in any style in seconds. AI generates text descriptions based on render and client brief.
showcase.approach: Three-module system: (1) Sketch/Collage to AI Render using React, Vite, Tailwind CSS with @excalidraw; (2) AI-generated narrative from project info and sketches; (3) AI critique comparing render to brief with score (planned).
showcase.methods: Intuitive sketching/collaging experience, StabilityAI API integration for rendering, OpenAI API for narrative generation, systematic documentation of iterations.
showcase.tools: React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, @excalidraw, StabilityAI API, OpenAI API
showcase.impact: Puts control of design ideation back to user with AI as digital assistant. Saves days/weeks compared to traditional ideation-to-render workflow. Working MVP available at: https://github.com/vigneshkaushik/Project-Draco. Future: public deployment, save options, iteration timeline.

useCases.title: Automated and Intelligent generation of Massing Models and Visualisation from Design Brief

showcase.problem: Every project begins with lengthy design brief requiring time to extract key parameters. Mundane but essential task to understand scale and complexity for fee quoting. Speed is critical for feasibility studies and design competitions. Manual testing using Excel and CAD is time-consuming and may miss optimal configurations.
showcase.proposedSolution: GenAI solution to automate extraction of key data from design briefs into standardized format, automatically refer to regulatory requirements, apply planning parameters, generate quick massing model, and create render in specified architectural style.
showcase.approach: Nine-step workflow: Botpress ChatGPT interfaces with user → retrieves key data from brief → looks up regulatory parameters from URA/BCA websites → generates JSON → Grasshopper generates 3D model from site polyline and parameters → sliders for optioneering → Stable Diffusion renders in specified style.
showcase.methods: ChatGPT AI for data extraction and code interpretation, parametric modeling with adjustable parameters, regulatory requirement automation, diffusion model for visualization.
showcase.tools: Botpress, ChatGPT, Rhino, Grasshopper, Stable Diffusion, URA/BCA regulatory databases
showcase.impact: Instant generation of accurate parameters vs. manual 2-3 days. Quick massing model and broad project overview. Future: fine-tuned parameters using ML, multi-option optimization, global jurisdiction support, BIM integration with IFC-SG, web/app interface for full project cycle.
